sql: SELECT "COURSE"."CRS_CODE" AS k, "COURSE"."CRS_CREDIT" AS m1 FROM "COURSE" WHERE "COURSE"."CRS_CREDIT" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank COURSE rows by course credit hours
